create.name: Gunaketu
create.bio:
Gunaketu, born Bjørn Kjønstad, is a Buddhist teacher in Oslo and one of the main teachers at the Oslo Buddhist Centre on Grünerløkka, part of the international Triratna Buddhist Community. He took up meditation in 1989 and was ordained into the Triratna Buddhist Order in 1996, the year he also began teaching. He is general secretary of Buddhistforbundet, Norway's umbrella body for the country's Buddhist groups, and has published articles and a novel in Norwegian.

At the centre he leads drop-in sittings, Thursday evening courses and weekend retreats grounded in Sangharakshita's presentation of the Dharma, with mindfulness of breathing and loving-kindness (mettā bhāvanā) at the core. He also holds a mindfulness teaching qualification and trained in gestalt work, which shows in his attention to the body and to how values become action. On Insight Timer he offers guided meditations in Norwegian and English and a six-day English course on what he calls conscious wellbeing, written with activists and others who care for the wider world in mind.

courses.title: Caring For Ourselves And The World: Enjoying Conscious Wellbeing
courses.description: A six-day Insight Timer course in English, around 23 minutes a day, on noticing your deeper values and living them more fully. Each day pairs a short teaching with a guided meditation and a practice to try, moving from the body and heart out to other beings and the earth.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Meditation evenings and courses at Oslo Buddhist Centre
courses.description: The centre's weekly programme in Oslo, where Gunaketu is one of the regular teachers: Wednesday evening and Thursday lunchtime drop-in sittings, Thursday evening courses on Buddhist themes, and weekend retreats. Drop-in sessions are offered on a donation basis; teaching is in Norwegian.
courses.price: Donation based (suggested 150 NOK, 75 NOK on low income)

free_resources.title: Meditasjon på kjærlig vennlighet - Metta Bhavana
free_resources.description: A 20-minute guided loving-kindness practice in Norwegian, following the traditional stages from oneself out to all beings.

free_resources.title: Meditasjon på pusten i 20 minutter
free_resources.description: A 20-minute guided mindfulness of breathing in Norwegian, the basic sitting practice taught at the Oslo Buddhist Centre.

flags: Email is the Oslo Buddhist Centre's office inbox (post@oslobuddhistsenter.no), not a personal address; he publishes none of his own.
Thin page: four items in all (one Insight Timer course, the centre's weekly programme, two Insight Timer tracks); the centre programme is the centre's, not his alone.
He is also a gestalt psychotherapist with a private practice (Pustepause); the page is kept to his Buddhist teaching and the practice is not listed.
Insight Timer shows no play counts, so the two tracks were chosen as his core Triratna practices (also linked from the centre's meditation page) rather than by plays.
Insight Timer is client-rendered, so its bio could not be saved as HTML for the bio check; a plain-text copy of the profile details I read was checked instead.
Listed under his Dharma name Gunaketu (the name the centre uses); Insight Timer shows 'Gunaketu Bjørn Kjønstad'.
Free Buddhist Audio (talks linked from the centre) disallows Claude agents in robots.txt, so it was not opened; thebuddhistcentre.com is a known block and was not opened.
